description: Edit this existing tree into a mature apple tree with a broad rounded rich green canopy, warm brown trunk, and 10-14 clearly visible ripe red apples, each about 3 pixels across. Preserve the original silhouette, branches, trunk-root position, 64x80 canvas, native pixel density, crisp clustered shading and cozy top-down game style. Change only the species foliage and add fruit naturally among leaves. Keep the full tree inside the frame. Transparent background, no ground shadow, no text, no blur.
